data.title: Lexi gave Lulu and Georgia 3 stars. Check out the full review...
data.content:
* * *

## [Client Order](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6438193f734f97e68f9d50c6)
My company was ordering poufs for a project and we had checked the stock 3 days prior to ordering. We were notified that there were more poufs in stock than the quantity we requested. It did take about a day or two for us to pull a proposal and send to our client for review. Within that amount of time all of the poufs somehow sold out. I do understand that things sell quickly, but this has become quite frustrating as we now have to process a credit for our client and spend more time sourcing for our project even though.

April 6, 2023

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Apr 13, 2023

Hi Lexi,

We thank you for reaching out and we're sorry to hear about this experience as this is not what we want for any of our customers. We hope we can be of further assistance for future projects so we better service you and your clients. If you have any further questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to reach out to support@luluandgeorgia.com.
